tagline: A community marketplace powered by Apps Hub profiles.
description: Publish classified listings with photos, descriptions, categories, prices or free items. Browse a public catalog and manage your own listings with your existing Apps Hub account. Watch interesting listings, see owner-only view and watcher statistics, and start private conversations from either side. Desktop settings control categories, subcategories and listing validity. Premium adds credit-paid VIP packages that place promoted listings first.
capabilities: Public catalog with search, category and price filters.
Apps Hub accounts own and manage their listings.
Up to ten photos per listing.
Free items, location and optional public contact details.
Edit, activate, deactivate and delete personal listings.
Automatic expiry and reactivation of expired listings.
Bump an active listing once every 24 hours.
Desktop category, subcategory and validity settings.
Private conversations linked to listings, with unread counts and Apps Hub identities.
Per-listing currencies matching Regional Settings, with currency-specific price filters.
Watch listings and review them later from a dedicated Watched view.
Owner-only daily unique view counts and watcher statistics.
Sellers can start a private conversation with a watcher.
Premium VIP listings paid through administrator-defined Apps Hub credit packages.
